VERDICT: LGTM

The addition mirrors the established pattern in this class: `NOTIFY` is declared as a `static final Logger` right beside the existing `AUDIT` logger, with a Javadoc comment consistent with the surrounding fields. The emit call sits naturally alongside the other post-save logging lines (the two `AUDIT.info(...)` calls) and uses the same SLF4J parameterized-message idiom already used two lines above (`owner.getId()`, `owner.getMemberId()`). Logic is in the right unit (the `addOwner` handler, after `saveOwner`), nothing is duplicated, and no class or method is turned into a catch-all. A maintainer would find this natural.
